faq.a: The 50/30/20 rule suggests spending about 50% of take-home pay on needs, 30% on wants, and 20% on savings. It is a planning guideline, not financial advice — your real split depends on rent, debt and local costs.
Enter your savings goal amount and the date you want to reach it, and the planner works out how much you need to set aside each month from your money left over after expenses.
faq.q: How does the savings goal work?

title: Budget Planner — Free Monthly Budget & 50/30/20 Plan | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: This is a planning tool, not financial advice. It does not know your debts, taxes or local costs — for debt or tax decisions, talk to a qualified professional.
Don't treat the 50/30/20 split as a rule you must hit. In high-rent areas, needs alone can pass 50% — the planner shows the gap so you can adjust, not judge.
